q_en: (Sample) Who creates products in the Oribrix catalog?
q_hi: (Sample) Oribrix catalog mein products kaun banata hai?
exp_en: Only the admin creates products. Vendors pick from the master catalog.
exp_hi: Products sirf admin banata hai. Vendor master catalog se chunta hai.

q_en: (Sample) All documents are approved but the vendor can't log in. Why?
q_hi: (Sample) Saare documents approved hain par vendor login nahi kar pa raha. Kyun?
exp_en: Final approval is a separate step: Vendor action > Approved > Update status.
exp_hi: Final approval alag step hai: Vendor action > Approved > Update status.

q_en: (Sample) An order weighs 650 kg. Which Shiprocket service is used?
q_hi: (Sample) Ek order 650 kg ka hai. Kaunsi Shiprocket service use hogi?
exp_en: Normal is under 500 kg; Cargo is over 500 kg.
exp_hi: 500 kg se kam Normal, 500 kg se zyada Cargo.
